answer: Yes, we buy cars with open safety recalls, and an open recall doesn't change your offer; you can have it fixed for free at a dealer for your car's brand first, but you don't have to. The help center doesn't cover how an open insurance claim affects a sale, so please contact a store about that part. For the hail damage itself, list any damage you know about on the damage disclosure form (NW-DMG-1) before the inspection, since disclosed damage is already priced into your offer and won't lower it again. Note that we can't make an offer on a car with a salvage, rebuilt or flood title.
